Every raw argument is borrowed; owned wrappers remain unchanged. `provenance.json` pins the source files, normalized twelve-row fixture and complete 63-row static constructor-helper closure; every record retains its exact original full-CAS SHA. Only optional top-level pretty is omitted. Upstream source is Apache 2.0 (LICENSE), copyright Microsoft Corporation, author Leonardo de Moura.

Range APIs use `[begin,end)` within live Array size, with no clamping. Forward and reverse use opposite slice indexing. Reverse empty is not the forward empty identity fast path. Lift canonical heap Nat parameters return identity, while immediate parameters narrow to unsigned32 before operation. Native result range is 20-bit bounded; unsupported panic behavior is not a fallback or successful clamp.

The six-family implementation scaffold is under independent source/control review. The parent integration agent ran the pinned native `--run` oracle: all 19 expected lines matched, exit 0, empty stderr (`native-receipt.json`). No AOT, fatal-path, allocation-parity or JVM execution result is inferred. The worker has run no JVM/native process; no initializer is replayed. The closure is complete for explicit static roots plus the nine original constructor helper targets; unknown dynamic/native edges remain a frontier. No initialized global or image root is added by this closure.
